conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Hi, I'm Susan, and I'm 26 years old. I'm here because my blood pressure has been really high lately, and I want to see if there's a new medication or diet changes that can help get it under control.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your age, gender, and a detailed description of your current symptoms or concerns?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 26 years old, and I'm here because my blood pressure has been really high lately. It's been getting worse, and I've been having some headaches, though I'm not sure if that's from the stress at work or the high blood pressure. I wanted to see if there's a new medication or diet changes that can help get it under control.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you provide more details about your family history of hypertension or other cardiovascular conditions? Additionally, have you been previously diagnosed with hypertension, and if so, what medications have you been prescribed?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I don't have any family history of hypertension or other cardiovascular conditions that I'm aware of. I was previously diagnosed with high blood pressure, and I've been on Norvasc, which I've had to increase to 10 milligrams a day. But it doesn't seem to be controlling my blood pressure as well as it should.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please share your current blood pressure readings and how frequently you have been measuring it?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: My blood pressure has been over 150, and I've been checking it at home regularly, but it's not been under control even with the Norvasc. That's why I came in to see if there's something else we can do.

conversation_turns.text: I don't have any recent blood tests or imaging studies done specifically for secondary causes of hypertension. I do know that my kidney function is good since I had a transplant a few years ago, and everything has been solid since then.
